demoUserAuth.name: X-Demo-User-Id
demoUserAuth.description: Local demo identity only. The server accepts it only when APP_ENV=demo and demo identity is explicitly enabled; it never grants research_admin privileges.

ClientRequestId.name: X-Request-Id
ClientRequestId.description: Optional client-generated request UUID. The server validates and echoes it; when absent, the server generates one.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable key for safe replay of a write request.

DemoUserId.name: X-Demo-User-Id
DemoUserId.description: User-scoped routes only. Accepted only when APP_ENV=demo and demo identity is explicitly enabled; production derives identity from bearer authentication. This header never grants research_admin privileges.

XRequestId.description: The validated or server-generated request UUID. It is returned on every operation response.

XTraceId.description: The trace UUID used to correlate the complete operation. It is returned on every operation response.

IdempotencyReplayed.description: True when an idempotent write response was replayed from the original result; false otherwise.

BadRequest.description: Malformed JSON or invalid HTTP protocol input

Forbidden.description: The caller cannot access the requested data or score view

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found

UnprocessableEntity.description: The request violates a domain constraint

TooManyRequests.description: The caller exceeded the configured request or concurrency limit

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the client should retry.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Core MySQL storage is unavailable, so recommendation cannot proceed

GatewayTimeout.description: The operation deadline elapsed before a safe result could be formed
